tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all MultiLocale projects the authenticated user has access to. Returns a bounded Markdown and structured preview of project ids, names, locales, and timestamps.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch a single MultiLocale project by id or name. Returns bounded Markdown and structured project metadata, including name, configured locales, and timestamps.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Create a MultiLocale project with a default locale and optional additional locales. Refuses to create a duplicate project name in the authenticated organization.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a MultiLocale project’s default locale, complete locale list, or translation context. Project names are intentionally not changed because phrases reference the project name.

tools.name: list_phrases
tools.description: List translation phrases for a MultiLocale project. Optionally filter by language or key. Returns a bounded Markdown and structured preview of id, key, language, and value.

tools.name: get_phrase
tools.description: Fetch translations for one exact phrase key in a MultiLocale project. Returns a bounded Markdown and structured preview across locales, or a single locale when language is provided.

tools.name: search_phrases
tools.description: Search translation phrases for a MultiLocale project by matching a query string against phrase keys and values. Returns a bounded Markdown and structured preview of matching ids, keys, languages, and values.

tools.name: find_duplicate_phrase_values
tools.description: Find keys in a bounded scan of one MultiLocale project whose default-locale translations have the same value. The result explicitly reports when the scan or output preview is truncated.

tools.name: find_missing_translations
tools.description: Report missing keys in a bounded scan of one locale or up to 10 configured locales, compared with the project default locale. The result explicitly reports partial locale or phrase scans and never creates translations.

tools.name: export_locale_dictionary
tools.description: Export one locale of a MultiLocale project as bounded, sorted key/value entries. Results are API-paginated with a maximum of 50 entries per call and each value is capped at 500 characters.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List a bounded roster for the authenticated MultiLocale organization. Returns only each member's display name and role. Email addresses, member IDs, role IDs, phone, country, and signup device details are excluded.

tools.name: add_phrase
tools.description: Create a new key in a project’s default locale and generate translations for every other configured locale. Omit value to use the key as its source value. Refuses to overwrite an existing key.

tools.name: update_phrase
tools.description: Update the translation value for a specific phrase key and language in a MultiLocale project. Phrases may be shared across projects — updating affects all projects that share the key. Clears machine-translation flags since the value is now human-edited.

tools.name: add_locale
tools.description: Add a new locale to a project and generate translations for every key currently missing in that locale. Uses the default-locale value as the source for each translation.

tools.name: share_phrase
tools.description: Attach every locale translation for one key in a source project to one or more target projects. The underlying phrase rows become shared, so future edits affect every attached project.

tools.name: delete_phrase
tools.description: Permanently delete every locale translation for one key in a project. If a phrase is shared with other projects, this deletes the shared row for those projects too, rather than only detaching the project.

tools.name: show_project_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded overview for a known MultiLocale project. Use this after listing projects or when the user provides a project id or name. It shows safe project metadata and up to 24 configured locales without downloading the project phrase dictionary.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "update_project" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_team_members · Public sink: list_team_members, update_phrase, share_phrase · Destructive: add_phrase, delete_phrase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_team_members · Public sink: list_team_members, update_phrase, share_phrase · Destructive: add_phrase, delete_phrase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
